recipes.name: Baked piri-piri tilapia with crushed potatoes
ingredients: 2 red peppers cut into chunky pieces
drizzle of extra virgin olive oil
sentences: Heat oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7.
Add the peppers, drizzle with the vinegar and oil, season well and roast for 25 mins.
Season and bake for the final 10 mins of the potatoes’ cooking time.

recipes.name: Charred baby aubergine & toasted quinoa salad
ingredients: 4 baby aubergines each cut into 4 slices
150g pack soft herby goat's cheese crumbled
sentences: Cook for 6-8 mins or until they have a slight bend to them.
Toast for 5-6 mins or until lightly browned.
Reduce the heat to low and pour in enough water to cover 1cm above the quinoa.
Gently simmer for 15 mins, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has been absorbed.

Cook for 3-4 mins each side until lightly charred and tender. (Alternatively, brush the aubergines with 1 tbsp oil, put in a really hot griddle pan and cook each side for 3 mins or until lightly charred.
Brush the leeks with 1 tbsp oil and cook on either side for 4-5 mins or until charred.
Combine 3 tbsp of the olive oil with the cider vinegar and half the herbs.

recipes.name: Curried chickpea brothy pasta
ingredients: 700g leftover coconut, curry leaf & turmeric saucy lentils (see step 1)
sentences: Stir in the onion with a pinch of salt and cook for 8-10 mins until softening around the edges.
Mix in the tomato purée and cook for a further 3-5 mins until darkened and caramelised.
Bring to a gentle simmer and let it bubble away for 6-8 mins.
Add the kale to the lentil mixture and cook for a further 5 mins.

recipes.name: Lazy summer tomato & sourdough traybake
ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil plus more for the tin
500g ripe tomatoes of all different shapes, colours and sizes, some cut into wedges, some halved across the middle (reserving all the juices and seeds)
2 thyme sprigs, leaves picked, plus more to serve
2 tbsp kalamata olives pitted and torn in half
1 ball of mozzarella torn into chunks
handful of watercress lightly dressed in vinaigrette, to serve (optional)
sentences: Oil a large brownie tin or roasting tin (about 35 x 25cm).
Put the aubergine in a sieve and scatter over ½ tsp salt.
Rub the salt all over the aubergine and leave to drain over a bowl or the sink for 30 mins.
Heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4.
Heat 2 tbsp of the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium to high heat, then add the coriander seeds.
Cook, stirring for 15-20 mins, until the aubergine is caramelised and soft in the middle.
Drizzle over the rest of the olive oil and bake for 20 mins.
Return to the oven for another 15 mins, until the sourdough is crisp and golden and the cheese is melted.

recipes.name: Minty pineapple smoothie
ingredients: 200g pineapple peeled, cored and cut into chunks
sentences: Put all the ingredients in a blender with 200ml water and process until smooth.
If it’s too thick, add more water (up to 400ml) until you get the right mix.

recipes.name: Pea, pesto & sausage lasagne
ingredients: 6 good-quality sausages meat squeezed from the skins and rolled into cherry-tomato-sized balls
small head of broccoli (about 400g), cut into small florets
sentences: Add the sausageballs and sizzle for 5-10 mins, rolling around until browned on all sides.
Meanwhile, bring a pan of water to the boil, add the broccoli and cook for 3-4 mins until really tender.
Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.
Put the tomatoes on a baking tray, drizzle over the remaining oil, season well and roast for 10 mins until just softened.
Scoop a third of the mixture into a casserole dish (mine was 25 x 35cm),top with a third of the tomatoes, then arrange three lasagne sheets on top.
Bake for 35-40 mins until golden brown and bubbling.

recipes.name: Rocket with a charred lemon dressing
Schmaltzy lentils with chicken, olives & lemon
ingredients: 500g cooked lentils tomato flavoured if you can get them
1 lemon half sliced and half juiced
50g green olives pitted and roughly chopped
small handful of parsley finely chopped, to serve
sentences: Cook for 6-8 mins until well browned and golden, then flip and cook for 2-3 mins until just golden, they don’t need to be cooked through at this point.
Cook for 2-3 mins before stirring in the spices.
Cook for 1-2 mins until fragrant, then splash in the chicken stock, scraping the bottom to remove any browned bits.
Bring to a simmer, nestle the chicken breasts back in, skin-side up and cook for 8-10 mins until reduced and the chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Vegetarian wellington
ingredients: 500g butternut squash peeled and cut into 1cm dice
small bunch sage leaves finely chopped
1 tbsp sesame seeds or poppy seeds, to decorate
sentences: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.
Toss the squash with 1 tbsp oil, half the sage and some seasoning.
Tip onto a baking tray and roast for 25 mins until tender.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan and fry the shallots for 10 mins until tender.
Add the mushrooms and fry for 15 mins until softened, and the liquid has evaporated.
Roll the pastry out on a floured work surface to a 35 x 45cm rectangle.
Spoon the mushroom and squash mixture down the length of the pastry, leaving a 7cm border along the top and 1cm on both sides.
Roll up and trim the pastry with a knife when it’s overlapping by 1cm.
Chill until for at least 30 mins, or up to 24 hrs.
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.
Brush the wellington with more beaten egg, sprinkle with the sesame or poppy seeds and bake for 45-50 mins until golden brown and puffed up.
Leave to rest for 10 mins before carving into chunky slices with a sharp knife to serve.

recipes.name: Very-berry oat crumble
ingredients: 400g strawberry hulled and halved if large
500g mixed berry and currants, such as raspberries, blackberries, blueberries, redcurrants or blackcurrants
ice cream or custard, to serve
sentences: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.

Put the flour, oats, butter and sugar in a bowl, squash together with your fingers into a crumble texture, sprinkle over a baking tray and bake for 10 mins, stirring and roughly breaking up halfway through cooking.
Can be done up to 2 days ahead, and stored in an airtight container.
When the crumble topping is cooked, sprinkle it over the fruit, and place back in the oven for a further 15 mins until bubbling and golden.
Leave for 5 mins before serving with ice cream or custard.
